status: exploratory extensions designed after inspecting original test results

tfidf.tokens: saved original tokenizer output before LM unk mapping
tfidf.selection: fit vectorizer and classifier on train; select validation macro-F1, lower C on ties
tfidf.final_fit: refit vectorizer and classifier on train+validation; test once
tfidf.scaling: L2-normalized TF-IDF; no additional dense StandardScaler

statistics.method: paired ordinary percentile bootstrap; same indices for every model
statistics.pairs: all six pairs among three saved LM classifiers and TF-IDF
statistics.p_values: exact two-sided McNemar; Holm correction across six pairs
statistics.scope: fixed fitted models; excludes training and split variability

random_frozen.initialization: same original LSTM constructor and seed
random_frozen.change: freeze complete randomly initialized input table only
random_frozen.selection: validation CE only; original training procedure

attribution: Extension ideas informed by the peer repository; implementation adapted independently to this project's saved data and protocols, with coding-assistant help.
